findings.evidence:
- New tracking path: `pkg/infoschema/infoschema_v2.go` `(*infoschemaV2).keepAlive()` updates `Data.recentMinTS` via CAS, and is called from `TableByID`, `TableByName`, `SchemaTableInfos`.
- Reporting path: `pkg/domain/infosync/info.go` `(*InfoSyncer).ReportMinStartTS()` calls `schemaTS := is.infoCache.GetAndResetRecentInfoSchemaTS(currentVer.Ver)` and can lower `minStartTS`.
- Reset implementation: `pkg/infoschema/cache.go`:
  `ret := h.Data.recentMinTS.Load(); h.Data.recentMinTS.Store(now); return ret`
  This is not atomic as a pair, so a concurrent `keepAlive()` CAS can be overwritten between the Load and Store and never be reflected in either the returned `ret` (this report) or the stored `now` (next round).
- Concurrency is real: `pkg/domain/domain.go` `infoSyncerKeeper()` calls `ReportMinStartTS` on a ticker while user goroutines execute infoschema APIs.
- Second confirmation: `go doc sync/atomic.Uint64` shows `Swap(new uint64) (old uint64)` exists, which would make the reset atomic and avoid losing concurrent updates.
findings.fix: Change `pkg/infoschema/cache.go` `GetAndResetRecentInfoSchemaTS` to an atomic swap: `return h.Data.recentMinTS.Swap(now)`.
findings.impact: Can intermittently drop the smallest infoschema snapshot TS used near `ReportMinStartTS()` boundaries, causing TiDB to report a newer `minStartTS` than required; GC safepoint may advance past the actually-used infoschema TS, reintroducing "GC life time is shorter than transaction duration" failures for infoschema-v2 meta reads (the bug this PR is trying to mitigate).
findings.later_fix_evidence: Checked `upstream/master` (f0813a369666ac6314e76f5e573e982fe50c8a09): `pkg/infoschema/cache.go` still uses `Load()` + `Store()` (no `Swap()`), so this is not fixed later.
findings.verify: Add a small concurrency unit test that repeatedly runs `GetAndResetRecentInfoSchemaTS()` in one goroutine while another calls `keepAlive()` with a smaller `is.ts`, asserting the reported value eventually reaches the smaller TS; run with `-race` to stress interleavings.
findings.what: `InfoCache.GetAndResetRecentInfoSchemaTS()` uses a non-atomic `Load()+Store()` reset, so concurrent `infoschemaV2.keepAlive()` updates can be lost, undermining the GC-safepoint pinning this change introduces.

subject: domain,infoschema: make infoschema activity block GC safepoint advancing (#58062)
summary: Adds infoschema-v2 activity TS tracking (`Data.recentMinTS`) and feeds it into `InfoSyncer.ReportMinStartTS()` to pin GC safepoint; introduces a High-severity lost-update race in the TS reset logic (`Load()+Store()` instead of atomic swap).
